verdict.rationale: Benchmark Email documents a built-in AI Assistant inside the email builder that writes copy and creates images, so users can hand off content-generation tasks within the product. The only evidence is a single marketing line, and its scope is limited to copy and image generation in the builder, not broader task delegation. Missing for 10: delegation of tasks beyond copy/image generation (e.g., building campaigns, segmenting lists, scheduling), detailed first-party docs on the assistant's capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: AI Assistant crafts copy and creates images right inside the builder.
